scene: The clock swings open, revealing a sunlit transit balcony filled with rides.
picture: Flat side view. Inside the opened clock wall, an outdoor sky terrace extends across the frame. The grandmother in her pink tracksuit stands centre-left holding her white dog's lead. Left sits a sleek yellow flying scooter. Centre floats a red double-decker hover bus at a platform. Far right, a striped gondola drone gently bobs.
shown: a sleek yellow flying scooter parked on the open terrace on the left
a tall red double-decker hover bus hovering by the middle dock
a striped gondola drone moored to a brass pole on the far right
